'''Alexandre Dufresne Their is Good In Him again''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Alexandre Dufresne]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13636">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13636 Their is Good In Him again], DeckTech (Alexandre "Lord Kenobi" Dufresne, 13 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13636/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13636/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018051804/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13636/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alexandre Dufresne]]
* '''Published:''' 13 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Their is Good In Him again''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 TIGIH Dufresne LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Another Their is Good in Him deck with smugglers and Speeders.
